title: 第25章 前往天元第26章 飞鸿酒楼
slug: 从部落开始我有一本山海经
content_zh:
不到一刻钟，秦氏部落的首战便结束了，众人无一受伤，当鬼影匪团首领彭左醒来时，看向周围歪七扭八的尸体，心下胆寒，长年的恶魔林历练，使秦氏部落的战士下手毒辣，太阳穴，双目，脖颈，胸口，四肢关节……彭左发现所有尸体上的伤口不是一招就使其失去战斗力，就是凶狠至极一招毙命，仿佛自己等人是被野兽袭击了一般。
处理完鬼影匪团，众人找到了他们的储备地点和二十多匹角马，大量的物资让一直过着野人生活的秦氏部落看的眼花缭乱，纷纷挑选起自己看中的战利品。
“醒啦？彭左大首领。”
一个低沉的声音耳边传来。
彭左抬头看去，就见到将自己击晕的那个青年面带微笑的坐在院中，身边还站着一个不苟言笑，一本正经盘着发髻的青年，青年直勾勾看着自己，眼神中带着厌恶之情。
彭左支撑着身体盘膝而坐，腹部还在因为那一脚而隐隐作痛，头脑晕晕沉沉。
彭左微微转了转脖子道：“竟然没有将我捆绑，你就不怕我跑了？”
秦皓轻笑道：“你可以试试。”
随即又说道：“不如打个赌，你跑掉了，就算我输，你要是没跑掉又被抓了回来，那么跑一次，就断一指，这么算算你有十次机会，很划算！
哦，还有脚指没算在里面呢。”
彭左眼中凶光一闪，面色通红，这么多年，自己也多次在生死之间挣扎，今日竟被这青年如此嘲弄，这仿佛野兽在捕食之时对猎物的玩弄，一遍又一遍，直到最后摧毁猎物的意志，想到此时，彭左心中除了发怒外，还有一丝悲凉。
心中百念，身体微动，当眼角余光看见屋顶蹲着一个人影，仔细看去原来是之前速度极快，一脚将自己踢飞的青年，只见他躲在屋顶，嘴里不知道吃着什么，看到自己后，笑呵呵的对着自己打了个招呼。
彭左身形一顿，随后便放弃了心中的打算。
秦皓笑着问道：“怎么，彭左大首领就这么认命了？”
彭左冷哼一声，道：“把你的把戏收起来吧，想问什么直说，不然你不会只把我一人留着。”
秦皓拍手道：“果然不愧是鬼影匪团的首领，那小子我就直说了。”
乌黑透亮的双眸盯着彭左，一字一句的问道：“告诉我你知道的烈青所有的事情！”
彭左听后瞳孔放大，烈青？这些人到底知道什么？他们是谁？
秦皓见彭左低头，淡淡的道：“我们的时间比较赶，还有好多事情要做，还是希望首领配合一下。”
谁知那彭左抬头，双目血红狞笑道：“哈哈哈，我不知道你们是谁，但是，如果你想问二少爷的事情，就死了这个心吧，我要是说了我会死的更惨，甚至生不如死。”

彭左的坚持让秦皓微微一愣，他猜测彭左的性格不会为了他人而守住底线的，他本身就是一个没有底线的人，这么说更能证明那个烈青应该在计划着什么。
“唉……”
秦皓微微一叹，道：“我本不想这样，花儿她们估计现在正在美滋滋的采购你们的战利品，这会打断她肯定不开心，到时候还是你受罪。”
说罢转头看了眼身边的秦洪生。
秦洪生点头便转身离去，没多久就见到他带着一个十三四岁的少女，少女梳着两个长长的双马尾，面容秀气，一双大大的眼睛充满了委屈和郁闷，撅着嘴跟着秦洪生来到了秦皓身边。
秦皓摸着秦花儿的头，笑道：“好啦好啦，做完事再去玩。”
秦花儿委屈道：“他们有好多好看的布，那些布比兽皮还要软的多，罗妙和余冬她们都在抢呢……”
秦花儿还想说着什么，瞬间感觉到一旁自己的队长秦洪生审视的目光，一下子闭上了嘴。
秦洪生眉头紧皱，“抢？她们把自己当土匪了？”
说罢拱手对秦皓说道：“族长我去去就回。”
秦皓点头后，秦洪生匆匆忙忙转身跑去，秦皓看着一脸得逞，嘴角轻笑的秦花儿，笑道：“你啊……”
秦花儿哼道：“我拿不着，也不能让她们拿着过来气我。”
秦皓笑着，指了指地上坐着的彭左，道：“让他把所有关于烈青的事情说出来，回头我让你随便选，最好看的带花纹的。”
content_en:
In less than a quarter of an hour, the first battle of the Qin tribe was over, and no one was injured. When Peng Zuo, the leader of the ghost bandits, woke up, he looked at the twisted corpses around him. He felt terrified. Years of experience in the demon forest had made the Qin tribe's warriors vicious. Their temples, eyes, neck, chest, limbs and joints... Peng Zuo found that the wounds on all the corpses had either made them incapacitated with one move, or were so vicious that they were killed with one move, as if he and others were attacked by wild beasts.
After dealing with the ghost bandits, everyone found their storage location and more than 20 wildebeests. The large amount of supplies dazzled the Qin tribe, which had been living a savage life, and they all picked out the trophies they liked.
"Are you awake? Chief Peng Zuo."
A deep voice came to my ears.
Peng Zuo looked up and saw the young man who knocked him out sitting in the courtyard with a smile. Next to him stood a serious young man with his hair in a bun. The young man looked straight at him with disgust in his eyes.
Peng Zuo supported his body and sat cross-legged, his abdomen still aching from the kick, and his head was dizzy.
Peng Zuo turned his neck slightly and said, "You didn't tie me up. Aren't you afraid that I would run away?"
Qin Hao chuckled and said, "You can try it."
Then he said: "Why don't you make a bet, if you run away, even if I lose, if you don't run away and are caught again, then one of your fingers will be cut off if you run away. So you have ten chances, it's a good deal!
Oh, and the toes are not included. "
A fierce light flashed in Peng Zuo's eyes, and his face turned red. Over the years, he had struggled between life and death many times, and today he was ridiculed by this young man. It was like a wild animal toying with its prey while hunting, over and over again, until it finally destroyed the prey's will. Thinking of this, in addition to being angry, Peng Zuo felt a trace of sadness in his heart.
With hundreds of thoughts in my mind, my body moved slightly. When I saw a figure squatting on the roof from the corner of my eye, I looked carefully and it turned out to be the young man who was very fast and kicked me away. I saw him hiding on the roof, eating something unknown in his mouth. After seeing me, he greeted me with a smile.
Peng Zuo paused for a moment, then gave up his plan.
Qin Hao asked with a smile: "Why, Chief Peng Zuo just accepted his fate?"
Peng Zuo snorted coldly and said: "Put away your tricks and just say whatever you want to ask, otherwise you won't leave me alone."
Qin Hao clapped his hands and said: "As expected, he is the leader of the Ghost Bandit Group. I'll tell you the truth about that kid."
Staring at Peng Zuo with his bright black eyes, he asked word for word: "Tell me everything you know about Lie Qing!"
Peng Zuo's pupils dilated after hearing this, Lie Qing? What do these people know? who are they?
Seeing Peng Zuo lower his head, Qin Hao said calmly: "We are pressed for time and there are still many things to do. We still hope that the leader will cooperate."
Unexpectedly, Peng Zuo raised his head with blood-red eyes and said with a ferocious smile: "Hahaha, I don't know who you are, but if you want to ask about the second young master, just give up. If I tell you, I will die even more miserably, or even worse than dead."
Qin Hao was slightly taken aback by Peng Zuo's persistence. He guessed that Peng Zuo's character would not stick to the bottom line for others. He himself was a person without a bottom line. This further proved what Lie Qing was planning.
"Alas..."
Qin Hao sighed slightly and said: "I didn't want to be like this. Hua'er and the others are probably happily purchasing your trophies now. She will definitely not be happy if this interrupts her. Then you will still suffer."
After saying that, he turned around and looked at Qin Hongsheng beside him.
Qin Hongsheng nodded and turned to leave. Not long after, he saw him bringing a girl of thirteen or fourteen years old. The girl had two long ponytails. She had a delicate face and a pair of big eyes full of grievances and depression. She followed Qin Hongsheng to Qin Hongsheng with a pout.Hao's side.
Qin Hao touched Qin Hua'er's head and said with a smile: "Okay, okay, let's go play after we finish our work."
Qin Hua'er said aggrievedly: "They have a lot of beautiful cloths, which are much softer than animal skins. Luo Miao and Yu Dong are all snatching them..."
Qin Hua'er was still about to say something, but she instantly felt the scrutinizing gaze of her captain Qin Hongsheng on the side and closed her mouth.
Qin Hongsheng frowned, "Rob? Do they think they are bandits?"
After saying that, he raised his hands and said to Qin Hao, "I'll be back soon, Patriarch."
After Qin Hao nodded, Qin Hongsheng hurriedly turned around and ran away. Qin Hao looked at Qin Hua'er who had a successful look on his face and chuckled at the corner of his mouth, and said with a smile: "You..."
Qin Hua'er snorted: "I can't hold it, and I can't let them hold it and make me angry."
Qin Hao smiled, pointed at Peng Zuo who was sitting on the ground, and said: "Let him tell everything about Lie Qing, and I will let you choose whatever you want later. The most beautiful one with patterns."
